She was married to Chuck Norris. She died on December 21, 2025 in Texas, USA.FamilySpouseChuck Norris(December 29, 1958 - 1989) (divorced, 2 children)ChildrenMike NorrisEric NorrisRelativesMax Carlos Norris(Grandchild)TriviaEx-wife of Chuck Norris. Chuck and Dianne met when Chuck was a junior in high school. After Chuck enlisted in the U.S. Air Force, he proposed to her in a letter. In December 1958, in Torrance, California, wearing his Air Force uniform, Dianne and Chuck were married in a traditional ceremony. Chuck was 18 years old and Dianne was 17 years old. They had a four-day honeymoon in Big Bear, California.
